Frequently Asked Questions

What benefits does Freightos offer importers/exporters?
Freightos’ digitized platform gives you access to competitive freight rates, enhanced supply chain visibility, and automated tools that save time and reduce costs.
How does Freightos simplify freight booking for businesses?
Freightos covers the entire booking process for importers and exporters by providing instant rate comparisons, easy online booking, and round-the-clock support, helping businesses of all sizes, including both SMBs and Enterprise teams, manage logistics effortlessly.
Is Freightos suitable for small businesses?
Yes. Freightos offers scalable solutions, such as Freightos Marketplace, designed to meet the needs of small and medium-sized companies without requiring any logistics expertise. Many smaller companies, including e-commerce businesses such as Amazon sellers, rely on Freightos to simplify and streamline their global freight processes.
How does the Enterprise solution optimize freight procurement?
Our Enterprise solution automates RFQs, benchmarks real-time rates, and provides comprehensive data insights to streamline and optimize your procurement process. Thousands of global logistics service providers trust our solution for automating pricing, quoting, and booking. Freightos Enterprise helps customers connect directly to them, optimizing spend and improving relationships.
What features are available for freight forwarders and carriers?
Our vendor-agnostic platform powers some of the world’s largest carriers and forwarders. Over 4,000 global freight forwarders, including nearly all of the top 20, rely on our forwarder pricing, quoting, and booking solutions, which are operated under WebCargo by Freightos. At the same time, hundreds of airlines, ocean liners, and trucking companies leverage our platform for rate distribution and online sales.
Can I integrate Freightos with my existing systems?
Yes, Freightos offers seamless integrations with various systems, such as ERPs (SAP, Oracle, etc.), TMSs (OTM, GTN, SAP TM, etc.), RTTVs (P44, 4Kites, etc.), and many more, to enhance workflow and data consistency through API connectivity.
